issues.title: README configures @ai-sdk/openai-compatible while Actualyze's OpenCode guide uses @ai-sdk/openai
Discovery on Actualyze's Anthropic base URL sets no limits for any model
Use the capabilities, modalities and cost in Actualyze's /v1/models list instead of one detail call per model
Setting reasoning: true on @ai-sdk/openai makes every thinking model outside OpenAI Responses endpoints fail with a 400
